disclaimer: Measured by evalkit against local Ollama on this machine. Each score is the harness metric on every row of the task file. The judge was not called: the task files point it at gpt-4o-mini, and this run did not use a paid API or a substitute grader. Cost is zero because these calls had no provider bill. Quantization and parameter size come from the Ollama show API for the tag that was requested. The CPU line comes from /proc. The inference library is the ggml shared object mapped into the llama-server process that served the calls.
procedure: Each model was stopped before the task. Samples ran one at a time, all rows of one model before the next model. The first sample of a model can include weight load in its latency. A fresh response cache was used, so none of these rows are cache hits.
